title: Filler: Hinata's Ointment
later: I-it's nothing... You're busy. M-maybe later...

offer.speaker: hinata
offer.text: U-um... Naruto got hurt in training again. I made this ointment, but... I can't just give it to him...

offer.speaker: hinata
offer.text: Could you... give it to him? Please don't say it's from me!

dialogue.speaker: naruto
dialogue.text: Ointment? For me? Whoa, thanks! ...Wait, who made it? This smells way too nice to be yours.

lines.speaker: naruto
lines.text: A secret what? Heh, whatever, it works great!

lines.speaker: naruto
lines.text: Hinata? Huh. She's kinda weird... but nice! Tell her thanks!

dialogue.speaker: hinata
dialogue.text: H-he used it? He's okay? ...Thank you. Really.
